description: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. – The Florida House on Tuesday approved a higher-education bill that would require preeminent state universities to reserve 95% of freshman seats for in-state students and cap foreign undergraduates from any single country at 5%, sparking debate over diversity and university finances.
title: House passes bill limiting out-of-state, foreign students at Florida universities » Berny Jacques for State Representative | Berny Jacques for State Representative
